RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Border clearance
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Defeat enemies eligible for combat credit across at least two separate battles.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Hive reckoning
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Only hostile large insects eligible for combat credit count.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Giant hunter's oath
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Only enemies with at least 180 base combat power count.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Thunder expedition
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: The killer must have at least 3 distinct Thunder path sources at the time of the kill.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Worldfire pact
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: The killer must have at least 3 distinct Flame path sources at the time of the kill.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Crimson campaign
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: The killer must have at least 3 distinct Blood path sources at the time of the kill.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Fearless vanguard
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Complete a demanding hunt across several battles.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Undying record
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: A long-term challenge for an established build.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Steel contract
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Deliver 1,200 steel from the current home map. Delivered supplies are consumed. Forbidden or fogged supplies do not count.

RimHex.HexBountyDef.label: Precision order
RimHex.HexBountyDef.description: Deliver 30 components from the current home map. Delivered supplies are consumed. Forbidden or fogged supplies do not count.
